title: Release Premium Loading Schedule — Loan Seasoning on Equipment & Vehicle Loans Total-Loss Releases
content:
**Schedule.** An Equipment & Vehicle Loans total-loss release premium carries a seasoning loading set by the whole months since the loan's funding date: 4 points are added when fewer than 12 months have passed, 2 points when 12 to 23 months have passed, and nothing when 24 or more months have passed. The loading is added to the product's partial release premium percentage before that percentage is applied once to the unit's share of principal.

| Whole months from the funding date to the release date | Points added to the release premium percentage |
|---|---|
| fewer than 12 | 4 |
| 12 to 23 | 2 |
| 24 or more | none |

## Both sides of each line

| Whole months since funding | Points added |
|---|---|
| 11 | 4 |
| 12 | 2 |
| 23 | 2 |
| 24 | none |

## Hypothetical illustration

A Used Equipment Loan (partial release premium percentage 110) funded 9 whole months before the release: the premium percentage is taken at 114 points before it is applied to the unit's share.
